title: Pokemon TCG Hippowdon Perfect Order 040/088 Reverse Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Hippowdon 040/088 Perfect Order Reverse Holo Pokémon TCG card is a rare collectible from the Me03: Perfect Order set, featuring the Fighting type attribute. Manufactured by The Pokémon Company in 2026, this English-language card showcases the character Hippowdon with a high HP of 150. The card is illustrated by Souichirou Gunjima and has a special EX attribute, making it a valuable addition to any Pokémon TCG collection. With a Stage 1 evolution and reverse holo finish, this card is a sought-after piece for collectors and players alike.
